evidence_quotes: Valmet delivers recovery boiler modification to Stora Enso Varkaus mill in Finland to improve reliability and cost efficiency

Valmet Oyj’s trade press release on August 28, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. EEST Valmet will deliver a recovery boiler modification including a new secondary superheater to Stora Enso’s Varkaus Mill in Finland.
data.date_evidence: Valmet Oyj’s trade press release on August 28, 2026
data.reason: The press release announces that Valmet has received an order to deliver a recovery boiler modification and signed a cooperation agreement with Stora Enso's Varkaus Mill.
